messages:
maria: Quick sync — who is the flipper for the feature-config rollout tonight? aiming for 22:00 PT. leaving safe defaults enabled by default, right?
ajay: I can take the flip if no objections. can pair with dominik for the smoke run.
dominik: I'll pair. planning a 2-step: 5% for 10m -> monitor -> 25% -> full. safe-defaults flag stays true until post-smoke.
maria: thanks. @tayla can you own observability while you’re oncall? need token-level latency and error spikes on the dashboard.
tayla: yep, I’ll watch dashboards and traces. I’ll also set an alert for >3% error rate in the first 15m.
sre-bot: reminder: Quiet window is active 21:45-23:30 PT. If rollback required, use the rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback
ajay: preflip checklist I ran: deps mapped, migrations none, feature-gate is config.new_routing true/false? currently false.
dominik: plan for smoke tests (manual + automated): 1) send sample request set via loadtest job 2) run ``curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/sim -d @smoke.json`` 3) validate token costs and latency p50/p95 in logs
maria: add a quick step to validate canary route hits correct model variant. we saw mismatches last time.
ajay: good call — I’ll include a short curl to check header X-Model-Version. example: ``curl -I -H 'X-Debug:1' https://api.redwood/...``
tayla: can we also pin logs to tenant "acme-inc" during canary so we don’t mix traffic in dashboard?
dominik: done — I'll scope the canary to tenant IDs in range for the 5% slice.
maria: rollback command for quick flipback for reference:
```
# revert flag to safe default
redwoodctl feature set config.new_routing false --org=acme-inc --env=prod
# verify
redwoodctl feature get config.new_routing --org=acme-inc --env=prod
```
ajay: rollback tested locally, works. I’ll be the one to execute if we hit the alert.
tayla: I’ll announce in #eng-platform when metrics look green and when we can proceed from 5% -> 25%.
sre-bot: scheduled deployment window check at 22:00 PT by ajay. Autocancel if no activity by 22:15.
maria: thanks all. final note: if latency p95 > 600ms or error rate > 3% at any point, we abort and rollback. otherwise proceed after 10m of stable metrics. :thumbsup:
ajay: copy. pairing voice channel: #deploys/22:00. ping me at flip time.
dominik: I’ll stand by for verification and post-mortem notes.
tayla: will post a short thread after to capture perf numbers.
maria: great — closing here. good luck! :rocket:
